resources.string: Lets Starmate operate apps on your phone when you ask her to in chat. While a task runs, it reads the screen of the apps you have allowed, sends that content to the AI model provider you configured, and taps, types and scrolls for you. It never operates banking, payment, wallet, brokerage or crypto apps, system settings, app stores, SMS, authenticator or password apps, and stops when a payment screen or password keyboard appears. When no task is running it does nothing. A bar with a Stop button stays on screen during every task.

Phone actions hand parts of your phone to an AI model. Please read all of this. The button at the bottom only works once you have scrolled to the end.

When you ask in chat, she can open the apps you have allowed and tap, type, scroll, go back and go home for you, one step at a time. You confirm every task before it starts. She only works inside the apps on your allowed list, which is empty until you fill it.

During a task, the text and buttons on your screen (and, if your model supports images, screenshots when needed) are sent to the AI model provider you configured, using your own API key. That can include messages, names and anything else that is on screen in those apps. Starmate has no server of its own; the content goes only to your provider, under their privacy terms.

AI models misread screens, tap the wrong thing, or misunderstand what you meant. Text on a web page or in a message can also try to trick her. Before she taps things like Send, Post, Delete or Confirm, she has to ask you, but she can still make a mess in the apps you allow. Only allow apps where a mistake would be easy to fix.\n\nBe especially careful with ordinary apps that can also take payments (chat, shopping, food delivery, ride hailing). Payment screens are recognised by the text on screen, and some checkout screens may not be recognised. It is safer not to allow these apps, or to turn off their one-tap and password-free payment first.

These rules are built into the app, not left to the model:
• She never opens banking, payment, wallet, brokerage, fund or crypto apps, even if you add them.
• She stops the moment she recognises a payment screen, transfer screen or password keyboard. This relies on the text on screen and can miss some apps; see the warning above.
• She never types into password fields, verification code, card number or ID fields.
• She never opens system settings, app stores, installers, permission screens, SMS apps, authenticators or password managers, or Starmate itself.
• She cannot start a task by herself. Only you can, from chat.
How to stop her at any time

While a task runs, a bar saying “Starmate is operating your phone” stays on screen. Tap Stop on it and the task ends immediately. Turning the screen off or turning the accessibility service off also ends it. A task also ends by itself after 25 steps or 5 minutes.
You can check what she did
Every step is written to the action log on this phone: the time, the app, the action and what the safety guard decided. The log stays on this phone and is not included in exports.
